children: the acquisition of a newly developed class A industrial facility located in Stafford, Virginia, for $172.1M.
The 935,000-square-foot facility is subject to a long-term net lease agreement with J.E. Richards.

"This acquisition represents an opportunity to invest in a newly developed, high-quality industrial asset supported by strong tenant credit and compelling long-term demand drivers," said David Gross, managing director at Morgan Stanley Real Estate Investing.

"The Northern Virginia region continues to benefit from significant investment in digital infrastructure, which is creating opportunities across the broader ecosystem of businesses and real estate that support its continued expansion," said Gross.

title: Morgan Stanley unit acquires industrial facility located in Virginia for ~$172M
